brief:
Opposition figures and commentators say Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is using Israel's Shin Bet security agency to overturn the election result and retain power, Middle East Eye reported. The accusations emerge following Netanyahu's electoral loss, with critics contending he is leveraging state security apparatus to reverse the democratic outcome rather than cede authority.

The claims reflect deepening political tensions in Israel as the transition process unfolds. Netanyahu faces mounting pressure from opponents who view his actions as an unconstitutional power grab.

title: Netanyahu accused of attempting coup after election defeat
